buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Table detailing requirement of hired vehicle through GeM 1. Hired vehicle should be 4*4 (WD), closed vehicle type (i.e. Bolero, Sumo Gold, , Scorpio or similar), required to travel even on kuchcha roads. 2. Hired vehicles during the period of contract shall have necessary valid motor vehicle do cuments as valid registration certificate (RC), Insurance certificate, All India Permit, fitne ss/medical certificate of driver, valid contract carriage permit, proof up to date tax pay ment, pollution certificate clearance and driving license of the driver (Commercial vehicl e) available all times. The details of the make and year of the manufacturer of the vehicl e, having commercial registration number, mileage (Kilometres covered per litre) should be specifically provided in the information to be furnished with the quotation. 3. Hiring charges to be paid for fifteen days or 4500 kms, which will include diesel charges . All the expenditures of vehicle repair (replacement of spare parts, lubricant engine oil, gear box and different coolant, tyres and tubes, battery) and any other expenditure pert aining to vehicle should be borne by the vendor. 4. Experienced driver (minimum of 3 years), having MMV-HMV license be provided and sala ry of driver shall be borne by the vehicle owner with whole responsibility. No extra char ges regarding lodging and fooding shall be paid. 5. In case of any breakdown for whatever reasons, immediate replacement (within 4 hours) of the vehicle with same specification and condition should be provided by the vendor. The vehicle should be maintained in neat, clean and perfect running condition.

6. In case reporting of vehicle and / or driver is not found at the designated time and place of duty as instructed by the field party (Consignee officer) of GSI, the consignee will be a t liberty to cancel/ reject the hiring service. 7. The vehicle must achieve minimum fuel efficiency of 11-12 KMPL. 8. The vehicle will be 24* 7 ready for on-duty services as and whenever called for field dut y as desired by the field party (Consignee officer). 9. Vehicle shall not be more than 3 years old from initial registration and also be in a good running condition during period of contract/agreement. 10. If the services are found unsatisfactory, the consignee office may give notice and termin ate this hiring agreement. 11. The driver should be polite and properly dressed and must observe all etiquettes & prot ocols while performing duty. 12. The supplier of the vehicle shall not give the said hired vehicle to any other third party d uring the subsistence of the agreement. 13. Vehicle supplier should have at least 05 nos. of vehicles at his possession/ disposal so t hat they can replace the vehicle immediately in case of any exigency or break down. 14. The vehicle will be required at Bilaspur/Jabalpur on arrival of field work and dropping will also be at Bilaspur/Jabalpur on completion of field work. Note: Technical evaluation will be done on the basis of ATC required in Bid Document. . 4. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under.
